SLJ1.1.label: Resolved at 1LS
SLJ1.1.description: Definition: 1LS answered or completed it with no other team involved.

SLJ1.2.label: Rejected or out of scope at 1LS
SLJ1.2.description: Definition: 1LS itself declined it (policy, coverage, invalid, already correct).

SLJ1.3.label: Closed for no customer response
SLJ1.3.description: Definition: 1LS asked the customer for information that never came.

SLJ1.4.label: Redirected outside Scopus support
SLJ1.4.description: Definition: Customer sent to the publisher, another service or a self-service tool.

SLJ2.1.label: Escalated and resolved by 2LS
SLJ2.1.description: Definition: One hand-off; 2LS did the work or answered; relayed to the customer.

SLJ2.2.label: Escalated and rejected by 2LS
SLJ2.2.description: Definition: One hand-off; 2LS declined or found Scopus already matches the publisher (customer told to ask the publisher).

SLJ2.3.label: Escalated, outcome not visible
SLJ2.3.description: Definition: One hand-off; transcript ends without an outcome.

SLJ3.1.label: 2LS needed more information from the customer
SLJ3.1.description: Definition: 2LS asked (via 1LS) for details or proof; customer replied; case went back to 2LS.

SLJ3.2.label: Re-escalated after customer pushback or reopening
SLJ3.2.description: Definition: Outcome came back, customer disputed or chased, 1LS sent it to 2LS again. Preferred when several patterns apply.

SLJ3.3.label: Multiple hand-offs between teams
SLJ3.3.description: Definition: Passed across several teams, or repeatedly re-raised with 2LS.

SLJ4.1.label: Cannot tell from the transcript
SLJ4.1.description: Definition: Too short, only automated turns, or ambiguous.
